files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- Admin setting to enable or disable SSL certificate verification for the
  outbound SavaPage connection. Verification is enabled by default.

### Fixed

- SSL certificate verification (`CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER`) is no longer
  unconditionally disabled for SavaPage print requests.
- "Print to SavaPage" is shown again when a folder is selected. Current
  Nextcloud reports folder nodes with `type: "folder"`, which the file action
  treated as a non-directory.
